title: Apples for the Market
offer: Thanks to the bees, my trees are full of apples! Twelve baskets for the market in Kråkhamn. Only your boat can take them all at once.

steps.load_say: Red and green and yellow. Take one for the trip!
steps.say: Twelve baskets of apples! The whole market smells of autumn.

fact: The vikings ate wild apples, dried for the winter.
